relationships.subject: miR-150
relationships.evidence_quote: Then, we detected whether BDNF was negatively regulated by miR-150.

relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, our results verified that BDNF was directly targeted by miR-150 and inhibited by METTL3.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of BDNF in SNI rats could partly reverse METTL3-regulated suppression of NP progression in SNI rats

key_findings: Spinal METTL3 and m6A are reduced after SNI; METTL3 overexpression relieves neuropathic pain and neuroinflammation, knockdown induces pain in sham rats.
METTL3 promotes m6A-dependent (YTHDF2, DGCR8) maturation of miR-150, which targets BDNF mRNA 3'UTR, defining a METTL3/miR-150/BDNF axis.
